prompt.STACK: Scala 3 (JVM, Java 25) + Play Framework + Slick + SQLite, built with sbt
prompt.WORKERS: Play's Pekko HTTP server and default dispatcher with their thread pools sized to the core count

scanner.name: osv
argv: d=$(mktemp -d) && sbt -batch -error 'export Runtime/managedClasspath' > "$d/cp" && tr ':' '\n' < "$d/cp" | grep '\.jar$' | awk -F/ '{s=0; for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="maven2"){s=i;break}; if(!s){print "skip " $0 > "/dev/stderr"; next}; g=$(s+1); for(j=s+2;j<=NF-3;j++) g=g"."$j; print g":"$(NF-2)":"$(NF-1)"=runtimeClasspath"}' | sort -u > "$d/gradle.lockfile" && [ -s "$d/gradle.lockfile" ] && osv-scanner scan source --format json -L "$d/gradle.lockfile"
